name: Undaunted Bastion
lines: (5 items) When you use a taunt ability while you are under 75% Health, gain a damage shield that absorbs 14127 damage for 6 seconds. This effect can occur once every 10 seconds.

name: Undaunted Infiltrator
lines: (5 items) When you use an ability that costs Magicka while in combat, you increase the damage of your Light and Heavy Attacks against monsters by 1645 for 10 seconds.

name: Undaunted Unweaver
lines: (5 items) When you use an ability that costs Stamina while in combat, you increase the damage of your Light and Heavy Attacks against monsters by 1645 for 10 seconds.

name: Unfathomable Darkness
lines: (4 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) When you deal damage, you call a murder of crows around you for 12 seconds. Every 3 seconds a crow will be sent to peck the closest enemy within 12 meters of you, dealing 872 Physical Damage. This effect can occur once every 15 seconds and scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.

name: Unflinching Ultimate
lines: (5 items) Gain 1 second of immunity to crowd control effects after casting an Ultimate for each 20 Ultimate spent.

name: Unleashed Ritualist
lines: (2 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(4 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) Increases your pet damage done by 20%.

name: Unleashed Terror
lines: (2 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) When you deal direct damage with a Blink, Charge, Leap, Teleport, or Pull ability, you cut your enemy, causing them to bleed for 10 seconds, dealing 1870 Bleed Damage over the duration and applying the Hemorrhaging status effect every tick. This ability can occur once every 10 seconds per target and scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.

name: Valkyn Skoria
lines: (2 items) When you deal damage with a damage over time effect, you have an 8% chance to bring down a meteor that deals 1342 Flame damage to the target and 447 Flame damage to all other enemies within 5 meters. This effect can occur once every 5 seconds and scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.

name: Vampire Cloak
lines: (3 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) Adds 171 Weapon and Spell Damage, Gain Minor Protection at all times, reducing your damage taken by 5%.
